title: show-me: draw existing code from the source
author: bendrucker
body:
Scopes the grounding line from the previous candidate to explaining existing code, so a design stays with the Planning section.

#### Hypothesis

- Target: `declined-card/with` · `decline-path` rises.
- Guards: `design-order/with` returns to baseline, and every other `dev` grader on the with arm holds.

#### Result

`dev` tag against the `show-me-stop` baseline. Four runs a side for every case, topped up to eight on `declined-card` and `design-order`:

| Row | Baseline | Candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Case score `declined-card/with` | 0.50 | 0.75* |
| `declined-card/with` · `call-tree` | 0.25 | 1.00* |
| `declined-card/with` · `decline-path` | 0.13 | 0.50 |
| Case score `design-order/with` | 0.89 | 0.75 |
| `design-order/with` · `plan-order` | 0.75 | 0.38 |
| Reply words `design-order/with` | 303 | 392* |

Replies now trace the decline from the route handler through `checkout` as a call tree, where the baseline drew a generic processor diagram or stopped at `checkout`. The without arm held (0.72 to 0.63 on `declined-card`). No guard regression starred, though `design-order` slipped on plan order and grew longer. The line still reaches some designs that touch existing code, and those replies lead with file diffs before types. Holdout has not run on this candidate.

#### Runs

- Baseline: [35957027139](https://github.com/bendrucker/claude/actions/runs/35957027139), [35957031617](https://github.com/bendrucker/claude/actions/runs/35957031617)
